description: A full-featured WPF code editor UserControl for .NET 8. Syntax highlighting for 57+ languages via .whfmt syntaxDefinition (consumed from whfmt.FileFormatCatalog), Roslyn-powered IntelliSense + analyzers + refactorings, code folding, multi-caret editing, dynamic snippets with variable expansion, LSP semantic token colorization, Ctrl+Click navigation, inline hints / reference counts, debug data-tips, search and replace, split view, line numbers, minimap, and more. Zero external dependencies (no AvalonEdit / ICSharpCode).
releaseNotes: 0.9.9.0 — Phase 9 Inline Code Actions (Ctrl+. / lightbulb) with CodeActionRegistry + 3 mechanical fixers + Suppress-here; Refactor ▶ context menu + preview dialog + orchestrator (UI1-UI5); Phase 10B Duplication tab redesign (master/detail + side-by-side diff); Dynamic Snippets with variable expansion + user snippet store (#88); Phase 1 Debugger integration (Data Tips, Autos, edit-in-place, Run to Cursor); IDebugValueProvider + DebugValueHintsLayer contract; +10 new localizations (uk-UA, cs-CZ, vi-VN, hu-HU, ro-RO, id-ID, th-TH, el-GR, da-DK, fi-FI). 0.9.8.0 — LSP semantic token colorization; zoom snap-to-pixel; IReferenceCountProvider inline hints; Ctrl+Click links/emails; minimap scroll fix; SourceLink + satellite assemblies now correctly bundled.
title: WpfCodeEditor - WPF Code Editor UserControl
